portInfo.description: Porti Detar Sarandë’s history page describes a dedicated 180-metre cruise-ship pier (Pier No. 2) handling tourist ferries and cruise vessels roughly 100–210 m long, plus seasonal dolphin-type ferries. Saranda is a gateway to the Albanian Riviera and Butrint; entry rules are Albanian, not Schengen.
